identity.title: Fast and inefficient star formation due to short-lived molecular clouds and rapid feedback

analysis_steps.goal: Identify emission peaks and measure CO-to-Halpha ratio vs aperture size

method.value: Clumpfind peaks in each map; top-hat apertures; relative CO/Halpha ratio bias vs aperture size with Monte Carlo sampling to avoid overlap

evidence.quote: overlapping apertures are avoided through Monte-Carlo sampling from the emission peak sample and taking the average over $10^3$ such samples

key_parameters.value: apertures 20 to 2560 pc in steps of sqrt(2); flux range 2.0 dex below brightest peak, contour interval 0.5 dex

evidence.quote: The aperture sizes range from a spatial resolution $l_{\rm ap}=20$ to $2560~{\rm pc}$ in steps of a factor of $\sqrt{2}$.

validation.value: Clumpfind levels varied (1-2 dex range, 0.25-1 dex interval); results consistent within uncertainties or ~30%

evidence.quote: these experiments give results that are consistent with the numbers in Table [\[tab:fit\]] to within the uncertainties, or ${\sim}30\%$, whichever is largest

method.value: Fit analytical model for CO and Halpha-centred bias curves to get t_CO, t_fb, lambda, using Halpha reference timescale

evidence.quote: The free parameters of these expressions are $t_{\rm CO}$, $t_{\rm fb}$, and $\lambda$.

key_parameters.value: t_Ha,ref = 4.53-4.69 Myr over R=0-3 kpc; radial bins of 1 and 1.5 kpc width

findings_qualitative.value: GMCs are dispersed by photoionisation and stellar winds before supernovae

evidence.quote: shows that GMCs in NGC300 are primarily dispersed by photoionisation and stellar winds

claims.hypothesis: Star formation within GMCs is fast and inefficient rather than slow and efficient
claims.experiment: Measure CO-to-Halpha flux ratio vs aperture size and fit timeline model
claims.finding: GMCs live about one dynamical time, with low integrated SFE

evidence.quote: This feedback limits GMC lifetimes to about one dynamical timescale ($\mathbf{\sim}$10 Myr), with integrated star formation efficiencies of only 2$\mathbf{-}$3%.

claims.experiment: Compare t_fb and v_fb to predicted timescales

why_this_data.value: NGC300 is the closest, face-on southern star-forming disc galaxy; method needs high sensitivity and resolution over a large field

evidence.quote: NGC300 is the perfect target for the first application of this method, as it is the closest ($D=2$ Mpc), face-on, star-forming disc galaxy accessible from the southern hemisphere.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Long GMC lifetime of 50 Myr (two model variants) rejected as incompatible with observed ratios

evidence.quote: These alternative models represent two extremes and show that long GMC lifetimes are fundamentally incompatible with the observed CO-to-H$\alpha$ ratios in NGC300.
